business_problem: simplify a compute-heavy healthcare data ecosystem spread across AWS, Databricks, and custom software so OM1 could deploy ML code faster, reduce maintenance, and keep PHI redaction efficient.
solution_summary: OM1 uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and Snowpark Container Services on Snowflake to simplify a compute-heavy healthcare data ecosystem spread across AWS, Databricks, and custom software so OM1 could deploy ML code faster, reduce maintenance, and keep PHI redaction efficient. Patient, claims, and clinician-note data are centralized in Snowflake so data engineers, clinical researchers, and ML teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. OM1 achieved 75% savings in processing costs using Snowpark Container Services to redact PII data and 100M+ clinical records redacted in less than 30 minutes to protect patient privacy.
